title: Check hashability before len in Categorical comparison operations
answers: Why does comparing a Categorical to an iterator raise TypeError object has no len?
How are iterators treated when compared to a Categorical?
Why check is_hashable before length matching in Categorical comparisons?
body:
Symptom: Comparing a Categorical to an iterator raises TypeError: object of type '...' has no len().
Root cause: pandas/core/arrays/categorical.py:_cat_compare_op checked len(other) on list-like operands before checking not hashable, failing on hashable iterators.
Fix pattern: Check not hashable before calling len(other) on list-like operands so hashable objects take the scalar-like path.
Constraints: Applies when operands can be hashable list-likes like iterators or category tuples; does not apply to unhashable sequence types.
applies: Comparison operations between Categorical arrays and other objects
